ev.q: Arguably the world's greatest Capitalism simulator
Managers, upgrades, and Angel Investors keep the numbers climbing
Starting with a lemonade stand and ending up with absurd amounts of money
you can just let it run in the background
it gets repetitive and boring real quick
some events force you to manually click for far >10 mins
The art style is simple and brilliant
my favorite aspect of the game: the story
I'm just trying to find out what the biggest number I can get to is
